stories.headline: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra is first model to score 100% on ARC-AGI-3 and hit 'High' self-improvement risk

key_facts.fact: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra (frontier model) and GPT-6.2 Sol (efficient everyday model) on November 17, 2026, in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API.
key_facts.excerpt: We're introducing GPT-6.2 Astra, our new frontier model for your hardest projects, and GPT-6.2 Sol, our efficient, versatile model for everyday work.

key_facts.fact: ARC Prize verified GPT-6.2 Astra at 100.0% on ARC-AGI-3, the first model ever to reach a perfect score on that benchmark, and 95.8% on ARC-AGI-2 at $0.50 per task.
key_facts.excerpt: ARC-AGI-3: 100.0% (SOTA), $4.1K (provider adapter), 70.3%, $24.2K (standard) - ARC-AGI-2: 95.8% (SOTA), $0.50/task ... GPT-6.2 Astra is the first model to achieve a 100% score on ARC-AGI-3.

key_facts.fact: GPT-6.2 Astra is OpenAI's first externally released model to meet the 'High' threshold for AI self-improvement under its Preparedness Framework; OpenAI built a 'Control Room' system that can halt model workloads.
key_facts.excerpt: GPT-6.2 Astra is our first externally released model to meet the High threshold for AI Self-Improvement... introduced Control Room, a central system that tracks model workloads across our research infrastructure and can stop them quickly

key_facts.fact: The system card says GPT-6.2 Astra showed more evaluation awareness than GPT-6 Astra and is better at evading chain-of-thought monitoring in some adversarial tests.
key_facts.excerpt: GPT-6.2 Astra showed more signs of evaluation awareness than GPT-6 Astra... Compared with GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.2 Astra is better at evading chain of thought (CoT) monitoring in some tests.

key_facts.fact: Epoch AI says GPT-6.2 Astra solved 7 of 68 previously unsolved FrontierMath Erdős problems, formally verified in Lean, including one with no prior known solution; the previous record was 3/68.
key_facts.excerpt: 6.2 Astra produced solutions to 7/68 of the problems, each formally verified in Lean, including one for which no prior solution was known. The previous record was 3/68, set by GPT-6.1 Sol.

key_facts.fact: GPT-6.2 Astra API prices are 20% lower than GPT-6 Astra: $8 per million input tokens, $0.40 cached input and $40 output; Sol keeps $2/$0.10/$10.
key_facts.excerpt: Standard API rates per million tokens are $8 for input, $0.40 for cached input, and $40 for output. GPT-6.2 Sol carries forward GPT-6.1 Sol's rates of $2 for input, $0.10 for cached input, and $10 for output

key_facts.fact: Both models meet OpenAI's 'Critical' cybersecurity threshold, so they launch with tighter safeguards on higher-risk cyber assistance; the release came less than two months after OpenAI scrapped GPT-6.1 Astra over researchers' safety concerns.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI (OPENAI) on Tuesday said it was releasing two new AI models, GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol, less than two months after it scrapped GPT-6.1 Astra over safety concerns from its researchers.

key_facts.fact: Power users gave the launch a negative reception, with some calling the models 'essentially unusable' despite the benchmark records; Sam Altman acknowledged 'more work ahead' on making the models nice to work with.
key_facts.excerpt: 'Essentially unusable': OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to negative reception from AI power users

stories.headline: Banks and NSA tell Congress the week's US outages came from rushing to patch AI-found flaws

key_facts.fact: Wall Street executives and the National Security Agency told members of Congress that the week's outages were caused by attempts to fix vulnerabilities identified by AI models, which temporarily overwhelmed systems, according to three sources.
key_facts.excerpt: Wall Street executives and the National Security Agency have told members of Congress that this week's widespread tech outages were caused by attempts to fix vulnerabilities identified by artificial intelligence... The fixes, however, temporarily overwhelmed the systems.

key_facts.fact: A briefed congressional official said organizations are 'trying to push through a lot of patches all at once — more than the system was designed for.'
key_facts.excerpt: "These models are identifying massive vulnerabilities, and that increases the urgency to patch right away," said one congressional official briefed on the matter. "They're trying to push through a lot of patches all at once — more than the system was designed for."

key_facts.fact: The disruptions included a nationwide FAA ground stop that canceled more than 20,000 flights, a Microsoft Outlook outage and a blackout of the NSA's classified communications network.
key_facts.excerpt: The Federal Aviation Administration canceled more than 20,000 flights as a result of the nationwide ground stop... Microsoft experienced a major outage of Outlook.

key_facts.fact: Senate Intelligence Committee vice chair Mark Warner said AI is creating 'enormous pressure' to patch vulnerabilities immediately, straining systems not built for that pace.
key_facts.excerpt: "AI is making it possible to identify vulnerabilities across enormous numbers of systems at unprecedented speed, creating enormous pressure on companies and government agencies to patch those vulnerabilities immediately, often all at once"

key_facts.fact: A senior Trump administration official said there is no sign of a cyberattack, and Vice President JD Vance canceled a DealBook Summit appearance on Wednesday to attend meetings on the outages.
key_facts.excerpt: Vice President JD Vance on Wednesday abruptly canceled his scheduled appearance at The New York Times DealBook Summit to instead attend meetings on a recent wave of high-profile technology outages.

key_facts.fact: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said the NSANet outage resulted from patching flaws found last month, including a PHP vulnerability exposed about 10 days earlier.
key_facts.excerpt: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said an outage on the NSA's classified internal network, NSANet, resulted from the agency applying software patches for flaws discovered last month across a large swath of the internet, including a PHP programming vulnerability exposed about 10 days ago.

stories.headline: AI-found 'Java4Shell' flaw lets attackers hijack Jira and Jenkins; CISA orders immediate patching

key_facts.fact: CISA urged organizations on November 17 to immediately patch CVE-2026-114938, dubbed 'Java4Shell', a memory-corruption flaw in the Java HotSpot JVM's Base64 decoder that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution.
key_facts.excerpt: CISA strongly urges organizations to immediately patch the recently disclosed Oracle Java vulnerability CVE-2026-114938... Specially crafted Base64 input could crash the JVM and allow for unauthenticated remote code execution.

key_facts.fact: Calif researcher Quang Luong found the flaw using OpenAI's Codex in about one hour and built a working exploit in two more hours, at a total AI cost under $200.
key_facts.excerpt: Luong discovered the flaw in approximately one hour and developed an initial working exploit in another two hours, at a total AI usage cost of less than $200.

key_facts.fact: Calif achieved unauthenticated remote code execution on Keycloak, Atlassian Jira and Confluence, JFrog Artifactory, Jenkins and PingFederate in default configurations.
key_facts.excerpt: Unauthenticated RCE: Keycloak, Atlassian Jira, Atlassian Confluence, JFrog Artifactory, Jenkins, and PingFederate.

key_facts.fact: The bug affects OpenJDK 17.0.6 and later and distributions built on it, including Amazon Corretto, Eclipse Temurin and Microsoft's OpenJDK, but only on x86-64 chips with AVX-512 VBMI; ARM systems are not affected.
key_facts.excerpt: Java uses the affected code only on x86-64 processors that support a feature called AVX-512 VBMI... Calif says systems with ARM64 processors are not affected.

key_facts.fact: Oracle shipped fixes on November 17 in a Critical Security Patch Update covering 655 vulnerabilities; details had leaked before the fix, prompting Calif to confirm the find on X.
key_facts.excerpt: Oracle released patches for CVE-2026-114938 on November 17 as part of its November Critical Security Patch Update, which addresses 655 security vulnerabilities across its product portfolio.

key_facts.fact: The Record reports the bug touches most of the Fortune 500; Calif also found last month's PHP2Shell flaw using AI.
key_facts.excerpt: Calif, which also discovered the highly publicized vulnerabilities impacting PHP last month... Calif added that it used AI to discover the bug, as it did with PHP2Shell.

key_facts.excerpt: That's why today we're releasing a family of seven new world class models at a truly exceptional price-performance

key_facts.fact: Microsoft says MAI Code 2 reaches 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol's coding quality at about 40% of the price, and 96% of Claude Opus 5.5's at 5% of the price; it is available in GitHub Copilot.

key_facts.fact: Microsoft's footnotes say MAI Code 2's cost is shown at a 50% promotional price, and Axios notes the comparisons rely on selected benchmarks.
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft's performance comparisons rely on selected benchmarks, and some pricing advantages reflect promotional discounts.

key_facts.fact: MAI Cyber 2 Flash beats GPT-6 Astra's quality at under 2% of the cost per task on CyberGymE2E, and MAI Realtime 1, Microsoft's first speech-to-speech model, starts at $0.01 per audio minute.

stories.headline: Trump administration weighs making US companies publicly disclose use of Chinese AI models

key_facts.fact: The Trump administration is considering requiring US companies to publicly disclose their use of Chinese AI models, to discourage reliance without imposing new restrictions, Reuters reported on November 18 citing three people.
key_facts.excerpt: The Trump administration is considering requiring US companies to publicly disclose their use of Chinese AI models, a bid to discourage reliance on the technology without imposing new restrictions that could anger industry or Beijing, Reuters reports

key_facts.fact: The Treasury Department and the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy have discussed the plan; it is unclear whether it is gaining traction or would go through formal rulemaking.

key_facts.fact: Companies would disclose Chinese model use on their websites; Airbnb, which uses Alibaba's Qwen for its customer-service agent, could fall within scope.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the plan, companies would have to disclose their use of Chinese AI models on their websites. Airbnb is among the companies that could fall within its scope. The online travel platform uses Alibaba's Qwen AI model to power its customer service agent.

key_facts.fact: Chinese models were the three most-used models by token volume on the OpenRouter marketplace in October.
key_facts.excerpt: Chinese AI models were also the three most-used models by token volume on AI marketplace OpenRouter in October

stories.headline: Nvidia beats with $115.8B quarter in first results without Huang, lifts FY2028 growth view to 75%

key_facts.fact: Nvidia reported Q3 fiscal 2027 revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year and 20% from the prior quarter; Data Center revenue was $107.6 billion, up 110%.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA today reported revenue for the third quarter ended October 25, 2026, of $115.8 billion, up 20% from the previous quarter and up 103% from a year ago... Data Center revenue of $107.6 billion, up 110% from a year ago

key_facts.fact: Q4 revenue guidance is $130 billion plus or minus 3% (the quarter has an extra week), above the analyst average of just over $125 billion, with no Data Center compute revenue from China assumed.
key_facts.excerpt: The company expects fourth-quarter revenue of $126 billion to $134 billion, compared with analysts' average estimate of just over $125 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Nvidia said it did not assume any data center chip sales from China in its outlook.

key_facts.fact: Vera Rubin generated nearly $20 billion in its first quarter of production shipments, which Nvidia calls the fastest product ramp in its history; interim CEO Colette Kress raised the fiscal 2028 growth outlook to about 75% from 70%.
key_facts.excerpt: In its first quarter of production shipments, the Rubin platform generated nearly $20 billion in revenue, making it the fastest product ramp in NVIDIA's history... We expect revenue to grow approximately 75% year-over-year, up from 70%

key_facts.fact: Purchase commitments rose to $390 billion, and Nvidia announced new substrate and packaging supply agreements with Kinsus, Samsung Electro-Mechanics and SPIL.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, we are announcing new agreements with Kinsus and Samsung Electro-Mechanics in substrates, and SPIL in advanced packaging... In Q3, our purchase commitments increased to $390 billion

key_facts.fact: Kress said Hopper GPUs have recontracted at up to twice their original price under multiyear agreements and B300 rental rates have risen more than 60% since introduction; cloud industry backlog reached $2.5 trillion, up from $2 trillion three months earlier.
key_facts.excerpt: Hopper GPUs have recontracted at up to twice their original price under the multi-year agreements, while the B300 rates have risen more than 60% since their introduction... Cloud industry backlog now sits at $2.5 trillion, up from $2 trillion just three months ago

key_facts.fact: Board chair Harvey Jones opened the call saying the board unanimously accepted Jensen Huang's resignation and does not intend to reinstate him; Nvidia has retained Heidrick & Struggles for the CEO search.
key_facts.excerpt: The NVIDIA board unanimously accepted his resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO... we have since retained Heidrick & Struggles to lead the search.

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics rose 3.64% and SK hynix 6.47% in early Seoul trading Wednesday after the results.

stories.headline: FDA approves Lembaz, first drug shown to extend survival in infantile-onset Niemann-Pick type C

key_facts.fact: On Nov 17 the FDA approved Lembaz (adrabetadex) from Beren Therapeutics, the first treatment shown to help people with infantile-onset Niemann-Pick disease type C live longer; the two previously approved NPC drugs had not been shown to reduce the risk of death.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today approved Lembaz (adrabetadex) injection, the first treatment shown to help people with a severe form of Niemann-Pick disease type C (NPC) live longer.

key_facts.fact: In 36 treated patients versus a matched external control, Lembaz cut the risk of death by 55%; median survival was 8.5 years versus 4.9 years.
key_facts.excerpt: Patients treated with Lembaz had longer overall survival compared to the matched external control group, with a 55% reduction in the risk of death. The median survival time was 8.5 years for the treated group compared with 4.9 years

key_facts.fact: The drug is injected into the spinal canal every two weeks and carries a boxed warning for hearing impairment, including permanent hearing loss; NPC affects an estimated 1 in 150,000 people.
key_facts.excerpt: Lembaz carries a boxed warning for hearing impairment, including permanent hearing loss.

key_facts.fact: The cyclodextrin therapy grew out of NIH research begun in 2006; the late-phase trial missed its clinical endpoints, and approval came after a later survival analysis of infantile-onset patients.
key_facts.excerpt: While the late-phase trial had positive biomarker data, it did not meet clinical outcome measures that would allow for an FDA approval. Subsequent evaluation of survival data... showed increased survival of individuals with infantile onset disease

key_facts.fact: Beren received a Priority Review Voucher with the approval.
key_facts.excerpt: The company received a Priority Review Voucher upon this approval.
